title: Three Weeks and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：headache　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 headache 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the doctor ① treated the headache that no nurse in the clinic would have recorded, and he said the treating was the whole of the week. The ② headache, meaning the pain itself and not the lamp, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a headache, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ headache in that clinic had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ headache at the far desk, meaning the ache they kept for the children to ask about and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A headache, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the doctor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the headache was the whole of the matter, meaning the trouble and not the pain. The ⑥ headache, meaning the trouble and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; headache, he said, is either something you treat or the only word that means both a pain and a trouble. He said the trouble is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ headache had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ headache of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in March, was one clinic and three weeks of recording; headache, he said, is either the ache at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ headache I remember is the pain recorded in the chart, which closed in 1995 and is still recorded as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ headache, my mother said in 1997, is the only pain that improves by being recorded; every headache, she said, is a trouble that has agreed to look like a pain. She said the trouble was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 头痛（指诊所里每一阵旁边的那一阵）
B. n. 头痛（指那阵痛感本身，与灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：treat the headache 医治头痛
D. n. 头痛（指留给孩子们学着问起的那一阵）
E. n. 痛症（抽象总称，指一处诊所的头痛之事）
F. n. 头痛（指病历里写到、被记下的的那一阵）
G. n. 麻烦、难题（指一件事里人人都忍却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 难题（抽象总称，指人人都忍却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: treated the headache that no nurse in the clinic would have recorded
The headache, meaning the pain itself and not the lamp
the headache at the far desk
the headache was the whole of the matter
the headache had become a line in a chart
The headache of the whole thing
A headache, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: treat the headache 意为“医治头痛”，1988 年那位医生把诊所里没有一位护士肯记录的一阵头痛做了一遍。
headache 意为“头痛”，指那阵痛感本身而不是灯，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
headache 意为“头痛”，指诊所里每一阵旁边的那一阵，每一阵旁边都有同一盏矮矮的小灯。
headache 意为“头痛”，指最远那张长桌留给孩子们学着问起的那一阵，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
headache 意为“麻烦、难题”，指一件事里人人都忍却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个麻烦就是那件事的全部。
headache 意为“难题”，指人人都忍却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵痛感，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
headache 意为“头痛”，指病历里写到、被记下的的那一阵，到 1993 年这一阵成了病历里的一行。
headache 意为“痛症”，医生三月写道，整件事的头痛之事是一处诊所和三个星期的记录。
headache 意为“头痛”，我记得的是病历里记录过的那一阵，1995 年痊愈了，至今仍被说成诊所里最安静的一阵。
headache 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，头痛是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的痛感。
